195    public static Map<Integer, Class<? extends HistoryLog>> LOG_MESSAGE_IDS = new HashMap<>();
196    public static Map<Class<? extends HistoryLog>, Integer> LOG_MESSAGE_CLASS_TO_ID = new HashMap<>();
197
198    static {
199        for (Class<? extends HistoryLog> clazz : LOG_MESSAGE_TYPES) {
200            try {
201                LOG_MESSAGE_IDS.put(clazz.newInstance().typeId(), clazz);
202                LOG_MESSAGE_CLASS_TO_ID.put(clazz, clazz.newInstance().typeId());
203            } catch (IllegalAccessException|InstantiationException e) {
204                L.e(TAG, String.format("could not instantiate %s", clazz), e);
205                e.printStackTrace();
206            }
207        }
208    }
209
210    /**
211     * Reads the typeId from the first two bytes of a raw history log.
212     *
213     * <p>Those bytes are a little-endian uint16 whose low 12 bits are the typeId. The top 4 bits
214     * are not part of the id and their meaning is unknown, see
215     * {@link HistoryLog#getHeaderHighNibble()}. This applies the same mask
216     * {@link HistoryLog#parseBase} already used, and matches Tandem's own Mobi Android app, which
217     * reads these two bytes little endian and masks with 4095 before resolving the log type.
218     *
219     * <p>Without the mask, a record carrying a nonzero high nibble produces an inflated typeId
220     * (opCode 55 with a nibble of 1 reads as 4151), misses {@link #LOG_MESSAGE_IDS}, and is only
221     * recovered by the retry ladder in {@link #parse}, which logs a warning for every such record.
222     * The masking also corrects dispatch for typeIds of 128-255, which the previous signed-byte
223     * arithmetic resolved to typeId+256.
224     */
225    public static int typeIdOf(byte[] rawStream) {
226        return Bytes.readShort(rawStream, 0) & 4095;
227    }
228
229    public static HistoryLog parse(byte[] rawStream) {
230        int typeId = typeIdOf(rawStream);
231        HistoryLog ret = parseWithTypeId(rawStream, typeId);
232        if (ret instanceof UnknownHistoryLog) {
233            L.w(TAG, "retry1 HistoryLog parse on typeId " + typeId + " => " + ((byte) typeId));
234            HistoryLog two = parseWithTypeId(rawStream, (byte) typeId);
235            if (!(two instanceof UnknownHistoryLog)) {
236                return two;
237            }
238            if ((byte) typeId < 0) {
239                L.w(TAG, "retry2 HistoryLog parse on typeId " + ((byte) typeId) + " => " + (((byte) typeId) + 512));
240                HistoryLog three = parseWithTypeId(rawStream, (((byte) typeId) + 512));
241                if (!(three instanceof UnknownHistoryLog)) {
242                    return three;
243                }
244            }
245        }
246        return ret;
247    }
248
249    private static HistoryLog parseWithTypeId(byte[] rawStream, int typeId) {
250        HistoryLog historyLog = null;
251        if (!LOG_MESSAGE_IDS.containsKey(typeId)) {
252            L.t(TAG, "unknown HistoryLog typeId "+typeId+": "+ Hex.encodeHexString(rawStream));
253            historyLog = new UnknownHistoryLog();
254            historyLog.parse(rawStream);
255            L.i(TAG, String.format("PARSED-EMBEDDED-HISTORY-LOG(typeId=%-3d, UNKNOWN): %s", typeId, Hex.encodeHexString(rawStream)));
256            return historyLog;
257        }
258
259        try {
260            historyLog = LOG_MESSAGE_IDS.get(typeId).newInstance();
261        } catch (IllegalAccessException|InstantiationException e) {
262            L.e(TAG, "could not instantiate "+typeId, e);
263            e.printStackTrace();
264            return null;
265        }
266
267        String name = MessageHelpers.lastTwoParts(historyLog.getClass().getName());
268        L.t(TAG, "found matching "+name+" HistoryLog typeId "+typeId+": "+ Hex.encodeHexString(rawStream));
269        historyLog.parse(rawStream);
270        L.i(TAG, String.format("PARSED-EMBEDDED-HISTORY-LOG(typeId=%-3d, %s): %s", typeId, name, historyLog.toString()));
271        return historyLog;
272    }
